# `m.economy.funding_conditions`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

US short-term funding conditions: policy, overnight, and repo rates, one row per day.

```python
m.economy.funding_conditions(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `date.gte` and `date.lte` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Date` |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | none |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Date` | String | Calendar date of the observation (YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `EffectiveFedFundsRate` | double | Federal Funds Effective Rate as a percentage (DFF series from FRED); published daily. | REST |
| `EffectiveFedFundsVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the effective federal funds rate calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. | REST |
| `FedFundsTargetLower` | double | Lower bound of the federal funds target range as a percentage (DFEDTARL series from FRED); posted every calendar day. | REST |
| `FedFundsTargetUpper` | double | Upper bound of the federal funds target range as a percentage (DFEDTARU series from FRED); posted every calendar day. | REST |
| `FedOvernightRepoTreasuryAmount` | double | NY Fed overnight repo operation amount against Treasury collateral, in billions of U.S. dollars (RPONTSYD series from FRED); reported on business days. | REST |
| `FedOvernightReverseRepoTreasuryAmount` | double | NY Fed overnight reverse repo operation amount against Treasury collateral, in billions of U.S. dollars (RRPONTSYD series from FRED); reported on business days. | REST |
| `FinancialCommercialPaper90dRate` | double | 90-day AA financial commercial paper interest rate as a percentage, quoted on a discount basis (DCPF3M series from FRED); reported on business days, with occasional source-level gaps. | REST |
| `InterestOnReserveBalances` | double | Interest rate paid on reserve balances as a percentage (IORB series from FRED); posted every calendar day. | REST |
| `NonfinancialCommercialPaper90dRate` | double | 90-day AA nonfinancial commercial paper interest rate as a percentage, quoted on a discount basis (DCPN3M series from FRED); reported on business days, with occasional source-level gaps. | REST |
| `Obfr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the OBFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `Obfr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the OBFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `ObfrVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the OBFR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. | REST |
| `OvernightBankFundingRate` | double | Overnight Bank Funding Rate (OBFR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and reported on business days. | REST |
| `SecuredOvernightFinancingRate` | double | Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and reported on business days. | REST |
| `Sofr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the SOFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `Sofr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the SOFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `SofrVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the SOFR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. | REST |
| `Tgcr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the TGCR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `Tgcr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the TGCR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. | REST |
| `TriPartyGeneralCollateralRate` | double | Tri-Party General Collateral Rate (TGCR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as a repo reference rate and reported on business days. | REST |
| `TriPartyGeneralCollateralVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the TGCR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
